metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/ replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory (1,048 controls; the replay ends at success after 948 controls) in both modes; it succeeds in two fresh processes with identical state hashes, also with float32-rounded rows. Harbor 0.23 (eai-dexhand:0.2.0, RCB_LIMITS_ENFORCE=0): privileged oracle 1 / nop 0, standard oracle 1 / nop 0; with Wuji, standard oracle 1 and privileged nop 0.

notes.layout: Both hands hang from the same six-axis wrist stage with the same wrist joints, ranges, gains and start targets: wrist_x/y/z are the world position of the grip point (on the whisk handle axis inside the closed hand at the start), wrist_rx/ry/rz serial XYZ rotations about it; each hand starts from its own frozen, settled grasp of the whisk.
